test_policy.notes: Saint Mary's College 'will not require an SAT or ACT score for college admission'; submitting scores is optional. For international applicants the SAT (450+ EBRW) and ACT (21+) can also be used in place of an English test.

requirements.notes: Apply through the Common App. Unofficial transcripts can be uploaded to the applicant status page for review (official final transcript required once admitted); transcripts in other languages need English translations; applicants from systems with external exams ((I)GCSE/A levels, CBSE, WAEC, etc.) must submit those results. Letters of recommendation are optional but encouraged. A Certificate of Finances signed by the student and any sponsor, with a passport copy and financial documents, is required; the page gives no dollar amount. The application fee is not stated on the pages reviewed (the 2023-24 CDS listed $60 for the Fall 2025 cycle).

deadlines.label: Fall term Early Action (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Non-binding. The page prints Nov. 1 without a year, so fall 2027 entry is assumed. Same dates are listed on the international page.

deadlines.label: Fall term Regular Decision (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: The page prints Jan. 15 without a year, so fall 2027 entry is assumed. A Dec. 1 deadline is also listed for spring term.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Applicants from countries on the college's exempt list are waived. Applicants whose medium of instruction was English for all years of high school may also be waived, subject to verification by an admissions counselor after the transcript is submitted. Accepted alternatives to a test: ELS Language Center Level 112 with a 2.75 GPA or higher, SAT 450+ in Evidence-Based Reading and Writing, ACT 21+. All scores must be taken within 2 years of the application. No conditional admission or ESL pathway is mentioned on the page.

english.notes: The page prints '4 iBT' for tests taken after January 2026 without naming the scale; it appears to be the new 1-6 scale.
Level C1 or higher; no numeric score is printed. PTE is not listed on the page.

aid.notes: International first-year merit scholarships are decided at acceptance, need no separate form, and are automatically applied for four consecutive years of full-time study (renewal depends on satisfactory academic progress). The international scholarships page says awards range from $2,000 to $38,000 per academic year; the international admissions page says $2,000 to $29,000. The page lists no per-award table. Departmental scholarships of $5,000 per year are available to selected incoming first-years. The pages do not say whether international students can receive need-based aid.

sat.note: The first-year admissions page prints the SAT school code as 004675.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is printed on the pages reviewed; confirm with admissions before sending.
